plain_english_policy: This bill (SB544) is a **judicial expansion measure** tied to local funding conditions. It creates a new circuit judgeship in Baldwin County’s 28th Judicial Circuit, contingent on the county commission approving the necessary budget for judge compensation and staffing through 2014. The policy direction would be:
evidence_quotes: This bill would create an additional circuit judgeship... conditioned upon adoption of a resolution by the Baldwin County Commission to provide the necessary funding... through 2014.

The first judge elected pursuant to this section shall serve for a six-year term, holding office from the first Monday following the second Tuesday in January after the general election at which that judge is elected.
